method.normalization: NFC and whitespace collapse; case, punctuation, diacritics and damage symbols retained
method.field_unit: Unique repository/path/pointer, collapsing repeated retrieval views only
method.identity_rule: Only explicit raw-source hash and source locus justify a shared-source relation. Equal short strings never justify an object, edition, language or witness merge.

field_dispositions.disposition_rule: Non-null source_binding_id: known digital source origin only; null: UNKNOWN_SOURCE_LINEAGE. No physical identity established. Group occurrence integers index these rows.

limits: No fuzzy/semantic equivalence, translations across languages or exhaustive edition genealogy.
